descriptionEn: Eight minutes, soy sauce, ginger, and hot oil. The simplest things done perfectly.
descriptionZh: 八分钟、酱油、姜丝、滚油。最简单的事情做到极致。

stepsEn: Score the fish 3 times on each side. Rub with Shaoxing wine and a pinch of salt. Place ginger slices inside the cavity and under the fish.
Steam over high heat for exactly 8 minutes (for a 600g fish). Do not lift the lid.
While fish steams, mix soy sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water in a small pan. Heat until sugar dissolves.
Remove fish. Discard any liquid that has collected. Pour the warm soy mixture over the fish.
Scatter spring onion shreds on top. Heat oil until smoking, then pour directly over the onions — they will sizzle dramatically. Drizzle sesame oil. Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 鱼身两面各划3刀，用绍兴酒和少许盐抹匀，姜片放入鱼腹和鱼身下方。
大火蒸恰好8分钟（600g的鱼），中途不要揭盖。
蒸鱼时，生抽、糖和2汤匙水入小锅，加热至糖溶化。
取出鱼，倒掉盘中蒸出的水，将热好的酱汁均匀浇在鱼上。
撒上葱丝。将油烧至冒烟，直接泼在葱丝上——会剧烈冒泡。淋麻油，立即上桌。
details.notesEn: The smoking-oil pour is the soul of the dish. It wilts the onion, releases the aroma, and cooks the surface of the fish one final time. Time the steaming precisely — one minute over and the flesh loses its silk.
details.notesZh: 滚油泼葱是这道菜的灵魂。它软化葱丝，激发香气，也为鱼做最后一次加热。蒸的时间要精确——多一分钟，鱼肉就失去了那种丝滑的质感。

descriptionEn: Lamb, carrot, onion and rice cooked together in one pot. Central Asian comfort food.
descriptionZh: 羊肉、胡萝卜、洋葱与米饭同锅焖制。中亚的抚慰之食。

ingrZh: 2杯 长粒米，提前浸泡30分钟
stepsEn: Heat oil in a heavy pot (ideally a kazan) over high heat. Brown lamb pieces until deep golden. Remove.
In the same pot, fry onions until caramelized. Add carrots and cook until softened.
Return lamb. Add cumin, coriander, salt and enough boiling water to just cover. Simmer 40 min.
Drain rice and spread evenly over the meat and vegetables. Do not stir. Press the whole garlic head into the center.
Add boiling water to cover rice by 1cm. Cover tightly. Cook on low heat 25–30 min until rice has absorbed all liquid.
Remove garlic. Stir from the bottom to mix. Eat with your hands — that is the correct way.
stepsZh: 大火热油（最好用卡赞锅），将羊肉煎至深金黄色，取出备用。
同一口锅炒洋葱至焦糖化，加入胡萝卜翻炒至软。
放回羊肉，加孜然籽、香菜籽、盐和足量沸水刚好没过食材，小火焖煮40分钟。
沥干米，均匀铺在肉和蔬菜上方，不要翻搅，将整头大蒜插入中央。
加沸水至高出米面约1厘米，盖紧锅盖，小火焖25-30分钟至米饭吸干水分。
取出大蒜，从锅底翻拌均匀，用手抓着吃——这才是正确的方式。
details.notesEn: The layering is the technique — meat and vegetables on the bottom, rice on top, steam doing the work. The garlic becomes impossibly sweet and mild after steaming. The correct vessel is a kazan, but a Dutch oven works.
details.notesZh: 分层是关键技术——肉和蔬菜在下，米饭在上，靠蒸汽完成一切。大蒜经过蒸制后变得极度甘甜温和。正确的容器是卡赞锅，但铸铁锅也可以。

descriptionEn: Air-dried overnight, honey-glazed, oven-roasted. Crispy skin is the whole point.
descriptionZh: 隔夜风干、蜂蜜上色、烤箱烘制。脆皮是一切的意义所在。

ingrEn: Hoisin sauce, spring onion, cucumber, thin pancakes — for serving
ingrZh: 1汤匙 麦芽糖（或额外蜂蜜）
甜面酱、葱丝、黄瓜条、薄饼——配餐用
stepsEn: Blanch the whole duck in boiling water 2 min. Pat completely dry. Mix honey, maltose, rice vinegar — brush all over the duck. Air-dry uncovered in the fridge overnight (minimum 12h). The skin must be completely dry.
Remove from fridge 1 hour before cooking. Preheat oven to 200°C.
Mix soy sauce, Shaoxing wine and five-spice. Brush inside the cavity. Truss the duck with the cavity sealed.
Place breast-side up on a rack over a roasting tray. Roast 30 min, then reduce to 180°C and roast another 60–75 min, basting with honey every 20 min.
Rest 15 min. Carve in thin slices — skin and meat together. Serve with pancakes, hoisin, spring onion and cucumber.
stepsZh: 整鸭放入沸水焯2分钟，完全拍干。将蜂蜜、麦芽糖、米醋混合，刷遍全鸭，不加盖放入冰箱风干隔夜（至少12小时），鸭皮必须完全干燥。
烹制前1小时从冰箱取出，预热烤箱至200°C。
生抽、绍兴酒、五香粉混合，刷在鸭腹内，将鸭腹开口封住并绑好。
鸭胸朝上放烤架，下垫烤盘，烤30分钟后降至180°C再烤60-75分钟，每20分钟刷一次蜂蜜。
静置15分钟，片成薄片——皮肉一起，配薄饼、甜面酱、葱丝和黄瓜条食用。
details.notesEn: The overnight air-dry is non-negotiable. Moisture is the enemy of crispy skin. The basting creates the lacquered finish. If you have a bicycle pump, inflate the skin from the neck before air-drying — it separates skin from fat and is worth the effort.
details.notesZh: 隔夜风干不可省略，水分是脆皮的敌人。反复刷蜜制造漆亮表皮。如果有打气筒，风干前从颈部给鸭皮充气——这能将皮与脂肪分离，值得那点麻烦。

descriptionEn: Cumin, chili flakes, salt. Nothing more is needed.
descriptionZh: 孜然、辣椒碎、盐。不需要更多了。

stepsEn: Pat lamb chops dry. Mix cumin, chili flakes, Sichuan pepper and salt. Rub generously all over the chops. Marinate at room temperature 30 min minimum.
Heat a cast-iron grill pan or outdoor grill until smoking hot.
Brush chops lightly with oil. Grill 3–4 min per side for medium (adjust for thickness). Do not move them once placed — let the crust form.
Rest 5 min. Finish with a final dusting of cumin and chili before serving.
stepsZh: 羊排拍干，将孜然、辣椒碎、花椒和盐混合，大量涂抹在羊排上，室温腌制至少30分钟。
铸铁烤盘或户外烤架烧至冒烟热。
羊排刷少量油，每面烤3-4分钟至五分熟（根据厚度调整），放上后不要移动——等待焦壳形成。
静置5分钟，上桌前再撒一层孜然和辣椒碎。
details.notesEn: The simplicity is the point. Xinjiang lamb needs nothing but heat, cumin and chili. Any further intervention is a mistake. The smoke is essential — do not attempt this on a low flame.
details.notesZh: 简单本身就是意义。新疆羊肉只需要高温、孜然和辣椒。任何多余的干预都是错误。烟熏气不可缺少——不要在小火上做这道菜。

descriptionEn: Boiled whole, pulled by hand, dipped in garlic and vinegar. Nomadic and primal.
descriptionZh: 整块水煮，徒手撕扯，蘸蒜醋而食。游牧本味。

ingrEn: For dipping: minced garlic, black vinegar, chili oil, fresh coriander
ingrZh: 蘸料：蒜末、黑醋、辣椒油、香菜
stepsEn: Place lamb in a pot of cold water. Bring to a boil, cook 5 min, then discard the water. Rinse the lamb and the pot.
Return lamb to the clean pot. Add onion, ginger, star anise, Sichuan peppercorns, Shaoxing wine and enough cold water to cover by 5cm.
Bring to a boil, skim any foam, then reduce to a steady simmer. Cook 1.5–2 hours until the meat pulls easily from the bone.
Remove lamb and let rest 10 min. Pull the meat with your hands into large chunks — this is deliberate, not lazy. Bones come out naturally.
Serve immediately with dipping sauce. The broth is for drinking alongside.
stepsZh: 羊肉冷水下锅，煮沸5分钟后倒掉水，冲洗羊肉和锅。
羊肉放回清锅，加洋葱、姜片、八角、花椒、绍兴酒和足量冷水，超过羊肉5厘米。
大火烧开，撇净浮沫，转中小火保持稳定沸腾，煮1.5-2小时至肉可轻松离骨。
取出羊肉，静置10分钟，用手将肉撕成大块——这是刻意为之，不是懒惰，骨头自然脱出。
立即上桌，配蘸料食用，汤可以随餐喝。
details.notesEn: The point of hand-pulling is texture — the meat tears along its natural grain, which no knife can replicate. The broth, strained and salted, is one of the finest things you can drink.
details.notesZh: 徒手撕肉的意义在于质感——肉沿自然纹理撕裂，这是刀切无法复制的。将汤过滤后加盐，是你能喝到的最好的东西之一。

descriptionEn: Poached chicken, Sichuan chili oil, numbing peppercorns, sesame paste. Cold and alive.
descriptionZh: 白斩鸡、四川辣椒油、花椒、芝麻酱。凉而鲜活。

ingrEn: Toasted sesame seeds, spring onion, coriander to finish
stepsEn: Bring a large pot of water to a boil with ginger and spring onion. Add chicken. When it returns to a boil, reduce to the lowest possible simmer. Poach 20–25 min — the water should barely move.
Remove chicken and immediately submerge in ice water for 10 min. This gives the skin its characteristic silky texture.

While chicken chills, whisk together chili oil, sesame paste, soy sauce, vinegar, peppercorn oil, sugar, garlic and ginger. Taste — it should be spicy, numbing, sour and slightly sweet simultaneously.
Chop chicken through the bone into bite-sized pieces. Arrange on a plate. Pour sauce generously over. Finish with sesame seeds, spring onion and coriander.
stepsZh: 大锅加水，放姜片和葱段，大火烧开。放入鸡，再次沸腾后转至最小火，保持几乎不动的水温，焖煮20-25分钟。
取出鸡，立即放入冰水中浸泡10分钟——这赋予鸡皮标志性的爽滑质感。
鸡浸冰水时，将辣椒油、芝麻酱、生抽、醋、花椒油、糖、蒜末和姜末调匀。品尝——应该同时辣、麻、酸、微甜。
鸡带骨斩成小块，摆盘，大量浇上酱汁，撒芝麻、葱花和香菜收尾。
details.notesEn: The ice bath is not optional — it is what makes this dish. The contrast between the warm sauce and the cold chicken, the numbing pepper and the bright vinegar, the silk of the skin and the richness of the sesame — this dish is about contrast.
details.notesZh: 冰水浴不可省略——这正是这道菜的精髓。温热酱汁与冰凉鸡肉的对比，花椒的麻与醋的爽的对比，鸡皮的爽滑与芝麻酱的浓郁的对比——这道菜的一切都关乎对比。

descriptionEn: Cast iron, high heat, butter basting. Medium-rare or nothing.
descriptionZh: 铸铁锅、大火、黄油淋制。五分熟，别无他选。

stepsEn: Remove steak from fridge 45 min before cooking. Pat completely dry. Season aggressively with salt and pepper on all surfaces — more than you think is needed.
Heat a cast-iron pan over highest heat until smoking. Add oil. Place steak — it should scream when it hits the pan.
Cook 2 min without moving. Flip. Cook 2 min. Then flip every 30 seconds for a final 2 min, building the crust.
Add butter, garlic and herbs. Tilt the pan and baste the steak continuously with the foaming butter for 1 min.
Rest on a wire rack 5–8 min. This is mandatory, not optional. Cut against the grain.
stepsZh: 牛排从冰箱取出后在室温放置45分钟，完全拍干，各面大量撒盐和黑胡椒——比你以为需要的要多。
铸铁锅大火烧至冒烟，下油，放入牛排——下锅时应该发出响亮的嘶嘶声。
不移动煎2分钟，翻面，再煎2分钟，最后每隔30秒翻面共2分钟，积累焦壳。
加黄油、大蒜和香草，倾斜锅身，用起泡的黄油不停淋制牛排约1分钟。
放在烤架上静置5-8分钟，这是必须的而非可选的。逆纹切开。
details.notesEn: Dry surface, ripping-hot pan, aggressive seasoning, proper rest. Every step has a reason. The resting allows the juices to redistribute — cut too early and they run out onto the board, not into your mouth.
details.notesZh: 干燥表面、极热铸铁锅、大量调味、充分静置。每一步都有其理由。静置让肉汁重新分布——切得太早，肉汁流到砧板上，而不是流进你口中。

descriptionEn: Doubanjiang, dried chilies, and dark soy. Spicier and more aggressive than Shanghainese.
descriptionZh: 豆瓣酱、干辣椒、老抽。比上海红烧肉更辣、更烈。

stepsEn: Blanch pork belly 5 min. Drain and cut into 4cm cubes.
In a wok, melt rock sugar to amber caramel. Add pork and toss to coat.
Add doubanjiang and stir-fry 1 min. Add dried chilies, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, both soy sauces and Shaoxing wine.
Add boiling water to just cover. Bring to a boil, reduce to low. Braise 1.5–2 hours, checking occasionally.
Uncover and increase heat. Reduce sauce until thick and glossy. The fat should be translucent.
stepsZh: 五花肉焯水5分钟，切成4cm块。
炒锅融化冰糖至琥珀色焦糖，放入猪肉翻拌上色。
加豆瓣酱翻炒1分钟，放入干辣椒、姜片、八角、肉桂、两种酱油和绍兴酒。
加沸水刚好没过，大火烧开转小火，焖煮1.5-2小时，偶尔查看。
开盖大火收汁至浓稠发亮，肥肉应呈半透明状。
details.notesEn: The difference between Hunan and Shanghai versions is doubanjiang and dried chili — the Hunan version has an edge, a heat that cuts through the fat. Chairman Mao allegedly ate this for breakfast. I believe it.
details.notesZh: 湘式与上海版的区别在于豆瓣酱和干辣椒——湘式带着锋芒，一股穿透肥腻的辣。据说毛主席把这道菜当早餐吃，我信。

descriptionEn: Su Dongpo's recipe, unchanged for a thousand years. Three hours, Shaoxing wine, patience.
descriptionZh: 苏东坡的方子，千年未变。三小时、绍兴酒、耐心。

ingrEn: 1kg pork belly, skin-on, cut into 6cm squares
stepsEn: Blanch pork belly 5 min. Remove and score the skin lightly in a crosshatch.
In a clay pot or Dutch oven, lay spring onions and ginger as a bed. Place pork on top, skin-side down.
Pour Shaoxing wine, both soy sauces over the pork. Add rock sugar. Do not add water — the wine is the liquid.
Bring to a boil, cover tightly with foil then the lid. Reduce to the lowest possible simmer. Cook 1.5 hours.
Flip pork skin-side up. Continue cooking covered another 1 hour. Uncover and reduce sauce until glossy.
Serve in the clay pot. The skin should be trembling and the fat completely translucent.
stepsZh: 五花肉焯水5分钟，取出，在猪皮上轻划十字花刀。
砂锅或铸铁锅底铺葱结和姜片，猪肉皮朝下放在上面。
淋入绍兴酒和两种酱油，放入冰糖，不加水——酒就是液体。
大火烧开，用锡纸封紧再盖上锅盖，转最小火，焖1.5小时。
将猪肉翻至皮朝上，继续盖锅焖1小时，开盖大火收汁至亮泽。
连砂锅上桌。猪皮应该是颤抖的，肥肉应完全呈半透明状。
details.notesEn: Shaoxing wine, not water. This is the whole secret. Su Dongpo supposedly invented this dish while exiled in Hangzhou, feeding it to the workers who helped him build a lake causeway. A dish with a story that old deserves respect.
details.notesZh: 用绍兴酒，不用水——这是全部的秘密。据说苏东坡被贬杭州时发明了这道菜，用来犒劳帮他修建堤坝的工人。一道有着这么久远故事的菜，值得敬重。

descriptionEn: Daikon, beef brisket, spiced broth. Hong Kong winter in a clay pot.
descriptionZh: 萝卜、牛腩、香料高汤。砂锅里的香港冬天。

ingrEn: 800g beef brisket, cut into large chunks
1 large daikon, cut into thick rounds
Beef stock or water to cover
stepsEn: Blanch beef brisket 5 min in boiling water. Drain and rinse.
Brown brisket in batches in a clay pot or Dutch oven over high heat. Remove.
Fry ginger briefly in the same pot. Return brisket. Add all sauces, wine, five-spice, star anise, tangerine peel and Sichuan peppercorns.
Add stock or water to cover. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 1.5 hours.
Add daikon. Continue simmering covered another 45–60 min until both beef and daikon are completely tender.
Serve in the clay pot. The daikon should have absorbed all the braising liquid color and flavor.
stepsZh: 牛腩冷水焯5分钟，捞出冲洗。
砂锅或铸铁锅大火将牛腩分批煎至上色，取出。
同一口锅短暂爆香姜片，放回牛腩，加入所有酱料、酒、五香粉、八角、陈皮和花椒。
加高汤或清水没过，大火烧开转小火盖锅焖1.5小时。
放入萝卜，继续盖锅焖45-60分钟至牛腩和萝卜均完全软烂。
连砂锅上桌。萝卜应已完全吸收焖汁的色泽与味道。
details.notesEn: The dried tangerine peel is the soul of the Cantonese spice palette — it adds a fragrant bitterness that cuts through the richness. The daikon is arguably better than the beef. It absorbs everything and becomes something else entirely.
details.notesZh: 陈皮是粤式香料的灵魂——它带来一种芬芳的苦涩，穿透浓郁的肉香。萝卜可以说比牛腩更好，它吸收了一切，变成了完全不同的东西。
